title: Sprout paper towel holders
text: Sprout paper towel holders. Bought these to dispense paper towels with ease at our annual seafood boil... we've tried several different methods.. one thing we know is that you need to be able to dispense the paper towels with one hand.  These work well with one hand... we use the warehouse brand paper towels that "double cut" so you can chose a short piece or a long piece - these holders held up well to one-handed tugs and pulls.  These also happen to look a little like "art" on the counter when they are not working too.  So that is cool.  I went with the turquoise... it is a brighter, clearer turquoise - meaning it's not dirty blue.  Really pretty in my opinion.  They show one picture holding what looks like TP and think you could totally put one of these on the back of your toilet or counter or next the the toilet and use it as a TP holder too. The base is weighted - just the right amount.  You will need to put them together and it takes a bit of strength to push the stem into the base - just FYI... My daughter helped me do it.  Long story short I love them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
